Billie Jean King Had Seen Other Sports Documentaries. She Wanted Hers to Be Different

How did Arnold Palmer order an Arnold Palmer? You know, the half-lemonade, half-iced-tea concoction named in his honor? Steve Politi, sports columnist at NJ.com, unearthed the answer years ago , at Augusta National Golf Club, where a waitress who served Palmer his drink told him: "He leaned over and said, 'I'll have a Mr. Palmer.'
